Class ScenarioPlan

java.lang.Object
traffic.sim.ScenarioPlan
public final class ScenarioPlan extends Object
A recorded traffic scenario: the exact ordered sequence of car arrivals (each with its driver properties) and emergency arrivals produced by a Phase 1 run.

This is what makes the Phase 1 vs Phase 2 comparison fair. Phase 1 runs first and records its generated demand into a ScenarioPlan; Phase 2 then replays the same plan (same cars, same spawn ticks, same seeking/aggressive/stubborn traits, same driver profile and body size) using the Phase 2 logic — instead of generating a brand new random run. Both phases are therefore tested against identical traffic demand.
